jobs.occupation: HMI Engineer to global company in Ludvika!
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
As an HMI Engineer, you will play an important role in designing, developing and implementing Human-Machine Interface (HMI) solutions for HVDC control systems. Your focus will be on creating user-friendly, efficient and reliable interfaces that meet technical requirements and quality standards.
You will work closely with engineers and technicians across different disciplines to ensure seamless integration of HMI solutions into larger control systems. Your responsibilities will cover several stages of the development process, including design, system integration, testing, troubleshooting and technical documentation.
You will also contribute your technical expertise to project activities and support the planning and follow-up of project schedules and budgets.
Responsibilities:
Design and develop user-friendly HMI solutions for HVDC control systems

Integrate HMI solutions into larger technical systems

Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimise system functionality

Test and troubleshoot HMI systems to ensure performance and reliability

Identify and resolve technical issues and software bugs

Prepare technical documentation, user manuals and specifications

Participate in project meetings and contribute technical expertise

Support project planning and follow-up of schedules and budgets

Who are you?
We are looking for someone with a genuine interest in technology and a strong willingness to learn and develop professionally. You approach technical challenges with curiosity, analytical thinking and a solution-oriented mindset.
You are structured, thorough and attentive to detail, with a natural focus on quality. You feel comfortable taking responsibility for your own work while also enjoying collaboration and knowledge-sharing with colleagues. Furthermore, you communicate effectively and thrive in an environment where different technical disciplines work towards common goals.
We are looking for someone who:
Holds a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a related field

Has several years of work experience in software engineering, HMI development, industrial automation or a related technical field

Has programming knowledge and experience working with SCADA systems

Has good communication skills English, both written and spoken

It is considered an advantage if you have good communication skills in Swedish
Practical information
Location: Ludvika
Start: According to agreement
Working hours: Full-time, weekdays during daytime
Employment: You will work as a consultant through A-hub for 12 months, with the ambition of transitioning to direct employment with our client thereafter
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer at Björkdalsgruvan
jobs.description:
Put your process expertise to work at Björkdalsgruvan. Solve technical challenges and turn your ideas into real improvement.
At Björkdalsgruvan, just outside Skellefteå, you will take on a varied and independent role as a Process Engineer, combining process analysis with technical improvements in the mineral processing plant. Working closely with operations, you will lead development projects aimed at improving and optimising production. You will also play an active role in modernising the plant, including enhancing process control and automation. You will be part of a flat organisation with short decision-making processes, a high degree of responsibility and real opportunities to make an impact.We are looking for someone with solid experience in process engineering, preferably from the mining industry, ore processing or mineral processing. We look forward to receiving your application!
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, hands-on problem-solving and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.
Swedish language lessons available if needed.
A flexible and stimulating work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.
Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.

Your Responsibilities
As a Process Engineer, you will provide technical support to the Processing Plant Manager and Operations Managers responsible for the processing plant and crushing operations. You will be responsible for ongoing process monitoring and lead improvement projects from investigation and planning through to implementation and follow-up.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Collecting and analysing process data, identifying deviations and optimising processes to ensure stable operations and improved gold recovery.
Investigating technical challenges related to flotation, grinding and reagent dosing.
Performing process engineering calculations and metal accounting.
Working with process flow diagrams, technical drawings and P&IDs as part of improvement projects.
Conducting laboratory-based process development and testing.
Collaborating with operations and maintenance teams on troubleshooting, planning and scheduled maintenance shutdowns.
Providing technical support to the processing plant, crushing operations and tailings facilities.
Participating in budgeting activities and contributing to systematic health, safety and work environment improvements.

The Bigger Picture
Your workplace will be the mineral processing plant at Björkdalsgruvan. This is a daytime position with flexible working hours based on trust and individual responsibility.
The plant uses ABB control systems, along with various systems for process monitoring and maintenance management. One of the current development priorities is reagent dosing, with the aim of automating process control to achieve a more stable, consistent and efficient operation.
Our Expectations
To succeed in this role, you will need:
A relevant university degree in Process Engineering, Mineral Processing, Chemical Engineering or a related field.
A good understanding of the relationship between chemistry, engineering and industrial processes.
Experience in technical problem-solving and process improvement.
The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, process flow diagrams and P&IDs.
The ability to work independently and turn analysis into practical, actionable solutions.
The ability to communicate effectively in English in a professional environment.

It would be particularly advantageous if you have:
Experience from the mining industry or mineral processing plants.
Knowledge of mineral processing operations, such as flotation and grinding.
Experience in technical improvement projects and industrial control systems.
Swedish language skills.

Interested?

You will act as the key interface between customers, sales teams, consultants, trainers, and global service organizations to ensure that our offers remain relevant, scalable, and commercially successful.

Experience in Offer Management, Service Portfolio Management, Product Marketing, Business Development, Consulting, or a related commercial role.

Experience working closely with sales organizations and cross-functional stakeholders.

What Makes You Successful 
You are customer-focused, commercially driven, and comfortable taking ownership of a service portfolio.

You enjoy working across functions, influencing stakeholders, and building strong relationships while ensuring service offerings remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.

jobs.occupation: Test Engineer - Stoneridge
jobs.description:
Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.
Objective of the position
Help us build the test systems behind safer, smarter vehicles.
At Stoneridge in Örebro, our Production Engineering team makes sure every product that leaves the line performs exactly as it should. As our new Test Engineer, you'll own the test solutions for new product introductions — designing them from the ground up — and continuously sharpen the tests already running in production. Your work directly shapes the quality, reliability and efficiency of technologies that go into commercial vehicles around the world.
You'll report to the Production Engineering Manager and work alongside a hands-on, cross-functional team that values curiosity and ownership.
What you'll do

Design and build production test software, methods and equipment for both new products and existing lines.

Specify, procure, install and validate new test systems — and keep current ones running at their best.

Be the go-to expert for production teams when test challenges, product changes or process changes come up.

Build and evaluate prototypes, giving the development team clear feedback to improve quality and manufacturability.

Own the documentation — test procedures, verification and training that keep knowledge in the team.

Drive the numbers that matter: test yield, downtime and PPM, and support quotations and approval workflows.

What you bring

BSc/MSc in Electronics (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years in test engineering, production or industrialization — automotive preferred.

Strong electronics fundamentals — you can read and create electrical schematics.

Experience with vision systems (Cognex VisionPro, AVT or similar).

Proficiency in graphical programming tools such as LabVIEW or Keysight VEE.

Solid grasp of statistics (Cpk, standard deviation); Six Sigma Green Belt is an advantage.

Professional level of Swedish and English.

Bonus skills: Minitab, C# and CAN protocols.

What we offer
You will be welcomed to a Fun, Diverse and Inclusive workplace, where we base our culture on our Core Values: Integrity, Customer orientation, Teamwork, Adaptability, Accountability and Social responsibility. This role is a central role in shaping the future within a multinational automotive technology company focusing on safety and security. We also offer you an opportunity for personal and professional growth in a fast‑growing, constantly evolving organization with competitive salary based on knowledge and experience.

jobs.occupation: Build Your Career in Family Medicine in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. 
Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden
Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.
We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.
Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
Professional Development
General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.
Relocation and Support
Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.
Your personal advisor will assist with:
medical licensing
relocation planning
practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.
Support for Your Family
Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.
We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.
Language Training
To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.
Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.
Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.
Living in Sweden
Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.
Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.
Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.
Requirements
We are looking for physicians who:
Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?
We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.
Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!
Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Head of Property Operations & Technical Services
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Facility Management leader to drive the development of safe, reliable, compliant and cost-efficient facilities for a multi-site logistics organisation.
The role combines strategic leadership with operational oversight. You will establish a shared FM strategy and governance framework, coordinate regional delivery and act as the main contact for the organisation’s central real estate function.
Key responsibilities

Develop and implement a common FM strategy, service standards, processes and improvement roadmap across regions and sites.

Lead and develop regional FM teams and facility coordinators, establishing clear responsibilities, objectives and ways of working.

Oversee facility services, building operations and technical maintenance to support reliable day-to-day logistics operations.

Coordinate maintenance, inspections, contingency arrangements and facility-related safety and compliance activities with relevant stakeholders.

Lead facility projects and support new site openings, customer implementations and operational changes.

Manage supplier performance, contracts, budgets and cost follow-up in collaboration with Procurement and Finance.

Drive energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives and continuous improvement while maintaining safety, compliance and service quality.

Build effective collaboration with operations, landlords, real estate, security and health, safety, environment and quality teams.

Your focus will be to create a coordinated FM function that strengthens local delivery, supports business continuity and meets the organisation’s evolving operational needs.
Essential requirements

Demonstrated leadership experience in Facility Management, property operations or technical services, ideally within logistics, industry, retail or a similar business operating across multiple sites.

Solid knowledge of integrated facility services, technical maintenance, mandatory inspections, supplier management, contracts, budgeting and cost efficiency.

Experience introducing consistent processes, developing teams and driving change across decentralised or geographically dispersed operations.

Strong commercial awareness and analytical skills, with the ability to translate operational requirements, financial data, risks and service results into clear priorities and measurable improvements.

Experience delivering facility projects and incorporating FM requirements into new sites, customer onboarding and operational changes.

A good understanding of how FM responsibilities connect with workplace health and safety, fire protection, security and environmental requirements, including clear allocation of accountability.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and collaborate with site teams, senior leaders and central corporate functions.

A hands-on, organised and results-focused approach to leadership.

Fluency in Swedish and English.

A relevant academic degree or equivalent professional experience. Professional qualifications in Facility Management or property management are an advantage.

A valid driving licence.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software Engineer - Radar team
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Engineer - Radar team
Do you want to work at the forefront of technology, where your creativity and ideas directly shape the next generation of intelligent surveillance? As an Embedded Software Engineer in our Radar team, you'll help develop world-leading radar and sensor fusion solutions that make a real difference. This is a permanent, full-time role based on-site at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden.
Who is your future team?
You'll join a small, supportive team of four dedicated software engineers. We value different perspectives, continuous learning and open collaboration. We work closely with colleagues in electronics, mechanics, software, signal processing and graphics to take innovative products from concept to market.
Our recent work includes advanced radar analytics, precise speed measurement and intelligent algorithms that keep improving for our users. We have also developed new ways of combining radar with PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) cameras, which enables powerful automated tracking. We build everything from standalone radar systems to integrated platforms that solve real-world surveillance challenges.
What you'll do here as Embedded Software Engineer
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll play an essential part in developing our new radar products. You'll work across the whole embedded Linux stack, so you'll see your contributions in everything from low-level drivers to the features our customers use every day. You will:
Be part of our product development team, building the next generation of radar products
Analyze, design and write software for features in our upcoming products
Find and fix issues wherever they occur, from Linux kernel drivers to applications

Who are we looking for?
You're curious and interested in technology, and you enjoy tackling challenges together with your team. You take initiative and do well in a workplace built on openness, creativity, trust, commitment, playfulness and encouragement.
As your closest manager, I will support your personal development, give you freedom and trust, and guide you in your career. - Peter Wahlberg, Engineering Manager
We'd love to hear that you have:
A couple of years of professional experience developing software in C++, or equivalent experience
Experience with Linux
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Bonus points for:
Experience with low-level programming on Linux
Experience programming FPGAs

What Axis has to offer
At Axis, you'll have the freedom to explore different technical areas, grow your skills, and shape your own career path. We offer a flexible work environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to work with cutting-edge technology in a global company.
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Life at Axis blog 
Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
Ready to act?
Axis knows the value of a diverse workforce. Diversity in teams creates a better working environment and encourages creativity, which is fundamental to our success. We welcome all applications. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.
If you have questions, please contact the recruiting manager, Peter Wahlberg, Engineering Manager, at 0701710068.
We review applications continuously, so don't wait. Apply today and help us build the future of intelligent surveillance!
This recruitment is handled solely by Axis Communications AB. We politely but firmly decline all contact from recruitment and consulting companies.
